name: Forsaken Island
source:
Forsaken Island is a story-driven adult visual novel packed with mystery, seduction, romance, and steamy hot sex scenes… all set on a breathtaking deserted tropical island.

You play as Remy, an ordinary guy expecting the vacation of a lifetime: a luxury resort, crystal-clear waters, and gorgeous girls all around.

But the dream quickly turns into something far more strange…

[from [url=https://flatbertgames.itch.io/forsaken-island]itch.io[/url]]
